newsitem.title: USA: Jason Q1 net off on price, margin pressure.
newsitem.headline: Jason Q1 net off on price, margin pressure.

text.p: Jason Inc said Wednesday price pressure and a mix of low-margin projects contributed to a decline in the company's earnings in the first quarter ended March 28.

The company reported net income of $2.2 million, or $0.11 a share, down from $2.6 million, or $0.13, in the same period one year ago. Sales increased to $125.2 million from $104.6 million in the first quarter of 1996.

"The decline was mostly in our Power Generation (equipment) division," Jason President Mark Train told Reuters. "There was some weakness in our industrial segment as well and some price level pressures in our new businesses, which are expected to produce in the second and third quarters."
Jason is an industrial growth company with operations in the automotive, power generation and industrial markets.
Its shares closed off 1/2 Wednesday at 6-1/4.
